name: Whiteheart Woods
source:
Just like every summer, Kevin takes a break from the noise and hustle of big city life. Bringing along a group of close friends, he leaves for a week of cabin camping on the shores of a remote lake, deep in the wilderness. But despite being known for its breathtaking, serene beauty and crystal clear waters, the area also holds a reputation for bizarre, unexplained happenings. 

It isn't long before the group begins to discover that there is more to Wright Lake than even the most outlandish campfire stories would suggest...

[From [url=https://nobreadstudio.itch.io/whiteheartwoods]Itch.io[/url]]

(Currently put on hold for indefinite time due to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nobreadstudio/whiteheart-woods-a-supernatural-mystery-visual-novel/posts/2569797]failed crowdfunding[/url])
translation:
和每年夏天一樣，Kevin暫時逃離大城市的喧囂與忙碌。他帶上一群親密朋友，前往荒野深處一座偏僻湖泊的湖畔小屋露營一週。Wright湖以令人屏息的寧靜美景與清澈湖水聞名，卻也因各種離奇、無法解釋的事件而聲名狼藉。

沒過多久，這群人便發現，Wright湖隱藏的秘密比最荒誕的篝火故事還要離奇……

[來源：[url=https://nobreadstudio.itch.io/whiteheartwoods]itch.io[/url]]

（由於群眾募資失敗，目前無限期暫停開發：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nobreadstudio/whiteheart-woods-a-supernatural-mystery-visual-novel/posts/2569797]群眾募資公告[/url]）
